package.name: rosbag2_dynamic_recorder_ui
package.description:
A browser UI for rosbag2_dynamic_recorder, served by a ROS node on the machine running it.
Run the node, open http://localhost:8088, and change what is being recorded by clicking checkboxes. No account, no cloud, no separate application to install, and no internet: the page is a single static file served from this package, so it works on a robot with no network access.
Depends only on rclpy and the Python standard library. Deliberately no web framework and no npm build step -- adding either would put an install barrier in front of the people this is meant to be usable by.
